scope: P2.5 offline development, SP20-2 nominal 25 C
initial_vrc_basis: Frozen development windows start after verified preconditioning rest. Zero is a polarization prior assumption.
Q_model: Diagonal continuous variance density times actual elapsed seconds; zero process noise on zero-dt transitions.
gap_rule: Three times the pooled DST 99.5th percentile of positive dynamic intervals, linear percentile. No gap evidence inferred from endpoint currents.
candidate_selection: Lexicographic minimization on nominal FUDS: worst per-run missing fraction, worst per-run FULL_DYNAMIC MAX absolute error (pp), unweighted mean per-run FULL_DYNAMIC RMSE (pp), grid order. DST nominal metrics retained as identification diagnostics.
noise_model: Independent zero-mean Gaussian voltage and current perturbations, one pair per distinct observation. Repeated identical observations share the original perturbation. Per-run seed uses the declared seed and frozen run order.
stress_scope: Illustrative injected conditions, not measured sensor specifications. Stress metrics are descriptive and do not select noise parameters.
exclusions: None based on voltage, warning or error. Physically impossible initial-offset scenarios are marked inapplicable rather than clipped.
